pixel: every art pixel is 2x2 screen pixels; draw with image-rendering: pixelated
repeat: for sliced pieces: the period of the repeating centre, [columns, rows] in screen pixels; with CSS repeat a run (box size minus the two slices) seams unless (run - tile) / 2 is a multiple of it

menu_button.use: Menu button (top left, replaces the web navigation bar in battle): his thin-rimmed dark square with small corner curls, a red gem set into the top rim, three bars.

button_small.use: Small square button (his, above the party frames); 9-slice with a flat centre; the trefoil emblem goes inside.

target_bar.use: Chained plaque for the targeted or hovered enemy (or the boss): 3-slice. Only his thin silver rail runs along the bar; each 80-px cap holds his finial (pale lozenge tip, rose stone, an open lyre of two loops with dark eyes) and a thin bronze arm along the top and bottom rails ending in a small curl, round the channel's rounded nose. The centre is one repeating column (any width works). The red fill goes in the window (its rounded ends follow the nose).

target_fill.use: Red fill for the target plaque channel (3-slice, stretch to the HP fraction).

chain_left.use: Chain from the top edge down to the round medallion's left gem.

chain_right.use: Chain from the end circle of the turn row: flat at first, then curving up to the top edge.

chain_sag.use: Chain hanging under the turn row; draw it under the bells so its ends tuck behind their bases.

chain_link.use: The short chain link between the last bell of the turn row and the end circle.

round_medallion.use: Round counter medallion ("RONDA" over the number, no box behind the word): his round rim of fine 1-pixel beads between two thin lines, four oval gems set on the bead line (red top/left, green right/bottom). The chains hang from its left gem.

init_active.use: Turn row: the acting unit, a gold square frame (portrait in the window).

init_ally.use: Turn row: an ally (round window, his muted steel-blue rim and thin base strip).

init_enemy.use: Turn row: an enemy (round window, his muted rose rim and thin base strip).

init_end.use: Turn row: the dark hatched circle that closes the round (a little larger than a portrait ring).

minimap_ring.use: Round minimap frame: his pearl band (bright at the upper left, grey toward the lower right) with a thin gold line on each edge, a gold scroll lace outside it; cardinal gems in pointed lozenge mounts on the band, diagonal gems in pointed lozenge mounts standing a little outside the ring (green, red at the lower left, as he painted them). The map shows through the round window.

bar_frame.use: Action bar frame: 9-slice (corners 24 px high, 44 px wide). His thin grey-silver rails, the dotted inner line, dark panel; his sparse wire lace down both ends (an S-curl every 8 px, open between) and a wire arm from each corner gem along the rail, the bottom ones ending in a scroll (red gems on top, green below). With CSS repeat, keep (width - 48) a multiple of 8 and (height - 48) a multiple of 16.

gem_red.use: Loose red gem stud in a gold bezel (corners, medallions).

gem_green.use: Loose green gem stud in a gold bezel (corners, medallions).

end_turn_gem.use: His small pink gem inside the panel, about 10 px down and left of the bar's top-right corner gem; a candidate for the end-turn control.

crest_strip.use: Raised crest over the action bar (3-slice; the centre repeats every 2 art pixels): one long trough (his capsule with rounded ends, double rail and dotted line), HP on the left half, chakra on the right; his dense scroll shoulders at both ends. The acting character medallion covers the middle. Its bottom row sits on the bar's top rail.

medallion_active.use: Acting character medallion: the portrait shows through the round window (ring centre at the anchor). His crown: small curls on the arch, a small boss, then on each side his big dark dome boss with a pale twin highlight, stepping down to a third small dark boss on the trough rail and a short wire tail. Red gem on top; his pale pearl at the bottom rests on the bar's top rail. Sits on the middle of the crest strip.

hp_fill.use: Red HP fill in the crest trough's left half (3-slice; 12 px tall, in the trough window).

chakra_line.use: The thin line through the chakra trough that the gems sit on (3-slice), centred on the gems.

chakra_red.use: Chakra gem (red): his compact rhombus gem, threaded on the chakra line (centre the gem on the line).

chakra_orange.use: Chakra gem (orange): his compact rhombus gem, threaded on the chakra line (centre the gem on the line).

chakra_blue.use: Chakra gem (blue): his compact rhombus gem, threaded on the chakra line (centre the gem on the line).

chakra_empty.use: Spent chakra gem (dark socket), on the chakra line.

move_trough.use: Movement bar trough, his (3-slice): a small pointed left end (the fill starts just after it) and a rounded right end; the teal fill goes in the window.

skill_slot.use: Skill slot frame: his warm gold, a two-step bevel lit at the top left, rounded corners and small corner curls. The window is open: put a dark backing (panel #16120c) and the skill icon (painted later) under the frame.

skill_slot_active.use: Skill slot, selected or hovered: the same frame in bright gold.

skill_tag.use: Number tag over a skill slot: his dark hexagonal shield with a dim bronze rim (the slot number, cream, in the label font).

item_slot.use: Item slot, greyed (his): double faint outline with rounded corners, dark well; the icon and label are drawn dim.

item_badge.use: His small dim blue count dot on an item slot (the count in the label font, dim blue-white #b4c4d2).

lower_plaque.use: Dark plaque under the action bar (3-slice): his triangular brackets of curved wire (a curl at the tip, the lit long edge ending in a curl, an S-scroll holding his small eye, an X of two crossing C-curves; mid bronze between the scrolls with a dark shadow round each, the background showing only under the X) and rounded plaque ends with a silver rail along the bottom; for the hint line or the combat log.

party_frame.use: Party portrait frame (9-slice): his thin olive-gold double line with slightly rounded corners and a small gold curl in each corner (over the portrait corner, like his); portrait window on top, two bar wells below (red HP at 3,29 4 high, green at 3,34 3 high, in art pixels).

party_ch_fill.use: Party frame second bar (his green; chakra), 3-slice.

glyph_placeholder.use: Faint placeholder in an empty skill slot until the owner paints the icons.

glyph_emblem.use: His small gold trefoil for the small button above the party frames.
